claims.summary: Observed: dialogue_runtime.rs scans model control markers; ExactKnownModelControlMarkerOccurrence (L29) separates raw bytes from semantic role; a marker is kept in output only if it has reference syntax (quoted/grouped/relation verb); scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) orchestrates, rebuilding remainder and tagging occurrences.
claims.disposition: Verified against complete source at bound SHA 902a0358. Preservation-only-if-reference-syntax is exact at L129-131 (remainder.push only when reference_syntax.is_some()); occurrence type L29; orchestrator L114-144. Precision: the top scan is a single left-to-right pass with nested helper rescans (reference_syntax->delimiter+relation; fragment_has_non_marker_bytes rescans), so 'multi-pass' is loosely descriptive, not literal multiple full passes. No mechanism error.

claims.summary: Snag: first_word_after (L89) uses split_whitespace + trim_matches; a complex punctuation mark or Unicode whitespace variant not captured by the !c.is_alphanumeric() && c!='_' filter could fail verb extraction, stripping or mis-preserving the marker.
claims.disposition: Non-manifesting on complete source. split_whitespace splits on Unicode White_Space (incl. U+00A0); the trim closure is a non-alphanumeric catch-all edge-trim (strips U+FEFF, U+00AD, punctuation runs); find(!empty) skips fully-punctuation chunks, so the allowlisted verb is still isolated. Grounded by committed regressions from prior reports 1786936281 (NBSP/ZWNBSP, tests.rs L3272) and 1786999457 (soft hyphen, L3325) + punctuation boundary L3230. The one genuine limit (format char inside the verb) fails closed = marker stripped, pinned L3348-3359. Concern preserved; hypothesis corrected, not domesticated.

claims.disposition: Duplicate of Test 1 already proposed by introspection_astrid_llm_1786814454 and _1787135542 at the same source SHA. Pinned by committed regressions scan_known_model_control_markers_preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts (tests.rs L2932), ...preserves_relation_after_multiple_punctuation_runs (L2884), grounds_first_word_after_punctuation_boundary (L3230), quoted_context_precedes_following_relation_verb (L2978).
